POSITIVE GEOMETRIC BARRIER FOR COHERENT CORNER GROWTH
31 October-1 November 2026. Solo derivation; no independent audit.

What is established
-------------------
This constructs a positive, diagonal syndrome observable for an interacting
family of actual plaquette membranes, not for a static set of fault births.
Native pair correction competes with pure coherent corner growth. The bound
is uniform in time, volume, a finite persistent bath's dimension and state,
and logical/reference/bath correlations. No dissipator matching the coherent
terms, extra data-noise floor, random pulse sequence, or physical monitor is
introduced. Logical error is assessed with the same fixed component-filling
decoder used in the retained N881 work.

The price is a substantial restriction on the Hamiltonian: its local syndrome
predicates preserve anchored Young-diagram shapes before the boundary is
reached. Ordinary unconditional single-face Pauli perturbations do not satisfy
that restriction. This is NOT the arbitrary-local-Hamiltonian threshold, a
low-dimensional controller, or a claim of practical advantage or novelty.

1. Physical generator and the allowed Hamiltonian
------------------------------------------------
Use the periodic 4D cubical toric code, 6 L^4 data qubits, six logical qubits.
The primal pair action at a vertex v and directions i<j is

    P_a = (I-S_(v,i))(I-S_(v,j))/4,
    J_a = Z_(v;ij) P_a.

The dual action uses the corresponding Z checks and an X face write. There
are 12 L^4 such pairs across the two CSS sectors. The two correctors below
are separate models, each with its own proof:

    L_active = kappa sum_a D[J_a],
    L_complete = kappa sum_a (D[J_a] + D[I-P_a]).           (1)

In the second model the actual complete pair channels have independent
rate-kappa Poisson proposal clocks. No assertion is made for every clock
realization. The first model has its actual active-jump Lindbladian, including
its different syndrome-coherence decay. We do not identify the two dynamics.

SOURCE AND COMPARATOR BOUNDARIES — 31 October 2026

Local sources actually inspected, read-only:

1. producer-workspace/REPORT.md
   Re-entry pointer. Separates original active, completed-pair and regularized
   generators; identifies the unresolved positive quantum occupation problem.

2. producer-workspace/CONTRACTIVE_BOUNDARY_REDUCTION.md
   Exact CP compression/recovery-frame reduction and Hamiltonian boundary
   susceptibility. The general positive concentration estimate remains open
   there. This checkpoint supplies one only for the new constrained catalog.

3. producer-workspace/POSITIVE_COMMITTOR_GATE.md
   Native strip obstruction to the unmodified classical diagonal potential,
   exact completed-channel coherence action and a one-face dressed effect.
   The geometric precursor halo here changes the diagonal potential, so it
   is not excluded by the sharp-committor principal-minor counterexample.

4. producer-workspace/GLOBAL_COMPONENT_RESUMMATION.md
   Sections 1-3: signed joint-component criterion, the activated-causal-shield
   gap, and relative cancellation. Neither that criterion nor the retained
   clock-averaged absolute Moebius bound is assumed proved in this checkpoint.

5. producer-workspace/PRINCIPAL_PAIR_THEOREM.md
   Exact anticommuting two-check/one-face model and the separate active and
   completed generators. The new Young-family proof uses the local rule and
   local homology; it does not invoke a stochastic domination theorem for
   coherent amplitudes or require the source's global probability constants.

Conventional primary predecessors, read in this warm chat:

* Aliferis--Gottesman--Preskill, quant-ph/0504218v3, Sec. 11.1.
  https://arxiv.org/html/quant-ph/0504218v3
  Specified-location coherent fault paths with an arbitrary shared bath are
  established FT machinery. They do not alone control an adaptive autonomous
  eroder's signed union. No priority claim for coherent fault-path calculus.

* Dunneweber--Styliaris--Trivedi, 2601.20818v3, Secs. V and VII.
  https://arxiv.org/html/2601.20818v3
  Synchronous local QCA threshold is the strong conventional architecture
  comparator. Its fully continuous-time threshold transfer is outlined with
  a formal proof left open; our 4D restricted perturbation result does not
  settle that separate low-dimensional controller problem.
